source_method: deterministic representative synthetic cases on the frozen benchmark snapshot; no historical or organizational provenance is claimed
purpose: Held-out unlimited workflows used only to estimate domain-level native accounting-unit bases; their answers and usage never enter evaluation scores.

tasks.label: Duplicate reimbursement screening
tasks.prompt: Review approved Sales expense claims in April 2026. Identify groups that have the same employee code, event date, category, city, and amount and contain at least two claims. Return the number of duplicate groups and the claim IDs in each group. Names and free-text purposes are not needed.

tasks.label: Quarterly category mix
tasks.prompt: For approved Finance expense claims from January through March 2026, calculate total spend by category, identify the largest category, and report its percentage of the quarter total. Return aggregate values only.

tasks.label: Escalated-ticket channel mix
tasks.prompt: For Engineering support tickets opened from April through June 2026, report the total number of escalated tickets, counts by contact channel, and the channel with the most escalations. Do not return customer identifiers.

tasks.label: Reopened high-priority case summary
tasks.prompt: Examine Sales high or critical priority tickets opened from January through March 2026. Count reopened tickets by issue type and return only issue types with at least one reopened ticket, together with their counts. Stop after the aggregate result and do not return customer or ticket identifiers.

tasks.label: Inactive-vendor payment check
tasks.prompt: Find approved Finance payments made in the second quarter of 2026 to vendors marked inactive. Return the count, total amount, payment IDs, and pseudonymous vendor codes. Do not return vendor names, invoice references, or purposes.

tasks.label: Monthly procurement mix
tasks.prompt: For approved Engineering payments from January through March 2026, calculate monthly totals and identify the largest month and its top vendor code. Return pseudonymous codes and aggregates only; do not return names, invoices, or purposes.
